sn35.95:1.1: atha kho āyasmā mālukyaputto ātāpī pahitatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mālukyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.95:1.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.95:2.1: etthadāni mālukyaputta kiṃ dahare bhikkhū vakkhāmi
sn35.95:2.2: yatra hi nāma tvaṃ jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto saṅkhittena ovādaṃ yācasīti.
sn35.95:3.1: kiñcāpihaṃ bhante jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto.
sn35.95:3.2: desetu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu sugato saṅkhittena dhammaṃ appeva nāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ appeva nāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti.
sn35.95:4.2: ye te cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā adiṭṭhā adiṭṭhapubbā na ca passasi na ca te hoti passeyyanti atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:5.1: ye te sotaviññeyyā saddā assutā assutapubbā na ca suṇāsi na ca te hoti suṇeyyanti atthi te tattha te chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:6.1: ye te ghānaviññeyyā gandhā aghāyitā aghāyitapubbā na ca ghāyasi na ca te hoti ghāyeyyanti atthi te tattha …pe…
sn35.95:7.1: ye te jivhāviññeyyā rasā asāyitā asāyitapubbā na ca sāyasi na ca te hoti sāyeyyanti atthi te tattha …pe…
sn35.95:8.1: ye te kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā asamphuṭṭhā asamphuṭṭhapubbā na ca phussi na ca te hoti phuseyyanti atthi te tattha …pe…
sn35.95:9.1: ye te manoviññeyyā dhammā aviññātā aviññātapubbā na ca vijānāsi na ca te hoti vijāneyyanti atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:10.1: ettha ca te mālukyaputta diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
sn35.95:10.2: yato kho te mālukyaputta diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati
sn35.95:10.7: tato tvaṃ mālukyaputta nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena
sn35.95:11.1: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavato saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
sn35.95:36.1: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.95:36.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ mālukyaputta mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn35.95:41.1: imassa kho mālukyaputta mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
sn35.95:42.1: atha kho āyasmā mālukyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn35.95:42.2: atha kho āyasmā mālukyaputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
sn35.95:42.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn35.95:42.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā mālukyaputto arahataṃ ahosīti.
